mechanism: Echinacea may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing diclofenac plasma concentrations and NSAID-related adverse effects, while both agents may independently increase bleeding and hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor for signs of diclofenac toxicity (GI upset, bleeding) and hepatic function; consider alternative herbal products or dose adjustment if concurrent use is necessary.
